action.reason: Unresolved spec conflict: implement.ts makes autoCommitTurnEdits return true only when HEAD changes. Spec §3 and US-004 AC-11 require true after a nonthrowing autoCommitIfDirty call on a dirty tree. implement.test.ts now explicitly pins false for a no-op commit.

rationale: The HEAD check avoids falsely claiming a commit, but changes the binding contract without a recorded ruling. Hold for human adjudication of that conflict; green gates do not resolve it. Any implementation correction must also reconcile the test asserting false.
